name: Solflare
notes: The insignia matches the kit's Solflare_INSIGNIA_Obsidian_Noir_BACKGROUND_Yellow.svg (#02050A on #FFEF46; alpha IoU 0.99, checked 2026-10-09), but the tile here is a composition: the insignia is 62.5% of the square tile, where the kit file draws it at 50% on its square artboard and the site's App-Icon.svg at 67% on a rounded tile.
